description: Expanding Land is a free multiplayer browser cell game with a dynamic circular arena that expands and contracts, FFA and Teams modes, and a C-based server. Human and server-controlled bot populations vary by arena.
serverTechnology: Pure C with OpenMP parallelisation (~5ms tick, ~8x faster than typical Node.js implementations)
antiTeaming: Delta-style exponential decay: base × pow(1.086, multiplier). Recovery: -0.005/cycle. Configurable: at_extra_decay_base, at_compensation, at_split_loss, at_eject_loss, at_virus_pop_loss, at_danger_loss.
dangerZone: Outer ring during map contraction; +0.01 anti-teaming multiplier per cycle
serverFeatures: Incremental food grid with O(1) bucket removal
Live /status endpoint (player count, spectators, uptime, map scale)
Cinematic death sequence (particle bursts, eater pulse, camera shake)
Virus jelly physics (dynamic spring physics + jagged spikes)
